system.description:
Effect

Increases the Burden to 2 and changes the effect of Photon Shield to a Greatshield instead of a regular shield. Reduces your evasion etc like a Greatshield would. You can deactivate the photon greatshield for 0 RP, but doing so ejects the shell and ends the effect.

Effect

Changes the Photon Shield effect to instead to create a stationary wall of light in front of you. This wall disappears when you move. The wall is a 1 way high cover with 20 HP and only allows ranged attacks to pass through it from your side. When you move, the wall is immediately destroyed. Once the wall is destroyed, the shell is expended and ejects from the artifice. May still choose to activate the original effect of Photon Shield.

Effect

Pie toss can be fired through the weapon to gain the increased range (does not affect the damage or transfer alloys).

Effect

You may make AoO’s as if this was a melee weapon with a 5ft threaten range.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

Poison can be pre-applied to the container and then sealed. Once the lid is opened and a missile is drawn, it is considered to be applied and begins to use up its application limit and duration.

Effect

Applying poison to this weapon costs -1 AP (min 0).

Effect

Enemies grappling you take 1d6 full pierce damage. When escaping a grapple, you also deal 1d6 full pierce damage to the creature grappling you.

Effect

Increases the damage bonus by +1

Effect

Increases the range of which it sucks in by 10ft.

Effect

The knockback distance is increased to 10ft.

Effect

When you make a heavy attack with this weapon, you may knock yourself back 5ft.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

Critical hits render the target prone regardless of if they hit or not.

Effect

Effect

name: Range Finder — Musket (Two-Handed) / Adjustable Lens Refractor Gun

system.description:
Effect

You add a range finder to the weapon. This does not increase its range, but does allow you to look through the lens for a +10 perception bonus against things further than 60ft away. In addition, you can tell how far objects are from you when doing this.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

Increases the range by 20ft when used on a downed ally.

Effect

This artifice can be attached to ranged weapons as well.

Effect

Your Sweeping Arc can now be used two times per round.

Effect

After you deal damage with a thrown attack with this weapon, you may move up to 30ft towards the target. Can only be done once per turn.

Effect

Can be used more than once, but requires repair in between them. This also takes up 2 C slots.

Effect

Can be used more than once. This also takes up 3 C slots.

Effect

Range increased by 60ft.

Effect

For every AP spent on basic movement, you gain +2 damage to your next attack with this weapon (up to a maximum of +4 dmg).

Effect

The recorder can mute or censor parts of the memory being recorded. This tampering may fool regular people, but an artifice check of DC20 will reveal tampering has been done.

Effect

The activation ability begins at +2 stacks, but the artifice cannot use the empower ability again after it ends until the end of the arc.

Effect

This clothing can benefit from material bonuses, but its burden is increased by 1.

Effect

You may use the cannon as a melee weapon that deals Physical(Bludgeoning) damage. Only does 4d6 heavy damage when used as a melee weapon.

Effect

This weapon cannot be disarmed.

Effect

When you make 3 attacks with this weapon in 1 turn, you may make an additional light attack.

Effect

Once per round when this weapon deals damage with a Heavy attack, you may make a Light attack against a different target within 20ft.

Effect

If you make a heavy attack that the target defends against, you do not trigger attacks of opportunity from them until the start of your next turn.

Effect

Once per round, you may make a basic unarmed Heavy attack with this limb to a target within 60ft.

Effect

If a target moves away from you when you attack with this weapon and your next attack this turn is a throwing attack using this weapon against that target, that attack gains lock on.

Effect

You and your allies movement with this artifice is considered a sidestep.

Effect

The range of the Grappling Hook Artifice is lowered to 20ft, but can be used to make a light attack that does exactly 1 damage with full pierce. On damage, the target can be pulled up to 20ft towards the user.

Effect

The artifice is made with two predetermined elements instead of 1. When activating it, you may choose which element is used.

Effect

The first time you miss with a basic Heavy atack in a round you can follow up with a light attack against the same target.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

You can separate the Giant Scissors into two pieces for 0 AP (Quick), allowing you to dual wield them. You can use Separation again to put them back together. The passive changes from Shearing to Shearing Flurry which instead grants +1 accuracy to unarmored targets.

Effect

When engaged in melee and you take a block or dodge action and then you are attacked by another melee attack by a different enemy, you may use block or dodge against that attack for 0 RP. Applies once per turn

Effect

Fall damage is reduced by 60ft while wielding.

Effect

While next to another ally with a shield or greatshield, you gain +1 Guard. (Only actual shields apply)

Effect

When spending at least 3 AP to move in one turn, your next basic defense costs 1 less RP.

Effect

The attack enhanced by the artifice also gains the Shieldbreaker keyword.

Effect

While it's active, everyone in the area also gains immunity to Static.
